basics.name: Durgesh Tiwari
basics.title: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with experience in full-stack development, microservices architecture, and cloud platforms.

highlights: Guided 200+ students in full-stack projects using Java, RabbitMQ, Spring Boot, Docker, and cloud platforms

Directed cross-functional collaborations during sprint cycles, resulting in improved communication flow between diverse technical teams while achieving completion rates above 90% for assigned tasks each term.

Improved API response time by 25% by migrating from a PHP monolithic system to a microservices architecture using Spring Boot, optimizing service communication and scalability under high-traffic conditions.
Designed and implemented a centralized API gateway using Spring Cloud Gateway, improving latency and security and boosting API throughput by 20%
Automated the CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins and Docker, cutting deployment time by 10% and ensuring consistent rollouts
Deployed Spring Boot apps in Docker containers on AWS EC2, improving reliability and scalability with health checks and auto-restarts
Implemented a microservices system with Spring Boot, improving data accessibility by 32% by efficiently sending data packets to an analytics API using RabbitMQ.
Utilized SpringCloud and MyBatis Plus to develop microservices, enabling seamless integration of various modules such as product, order, and inventory management
Developed full-stack projects, designing RESTful microservices and APIs with Spring Boot and enabling seamless microservice communication via Spring OpenFeign.

Enhanced system throughput by 25% during peak traffic by implementing token bucket rate limiting and optimizing Redis cache-hit ratios, reducing database load and improving performance under high concurrency.
